description: Branch R-SORT-3 Positions and controls on an ACCDB. T(K Text(255)) with 32 values built around the letter a: trailing spaces, tab, no-break space, zero-width space, soft hyphen, one and two combining marks in both orders, a leading combining mark, controls U+0001, U+001F and U+007F, CR, LF, CR LF, U+2028, U+3000, a leading space and tab, a space or tab between letters, embedded NUL before and after the letter, and a Null; an index IX_K built after the rows and an unindexed copy T0. Reads GROUP BY K (first ID, count) in key order, ORDER BY K, ID, and the IX_K walks on both. Asks which of these units are ignored, which are weighted, and where trailing and leading whitespace is trimmed.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
